name: Memento Mori
source:
Day after day of life in tedium, Azari is plagued by a strange dream of death. Initially brushing it off, they later come face to face with Layne, a once-fond shadow of their past who had been determined to never cross paths again. What's more, a mysterious force sends them both to the hauntingly familiar scene in Azari's dream. With no way out, the pair must put aside their feelings and work together to prevent the deaths of those in their dreams, while uncovering the truth behind each timeline.

[From [url=https://cosmicwishstudios.itch.io/memento-mori]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
日复一日的生活单调乏味，阿扎里却被一个奇怪的死亡梦所困扰。起初他们对此不予理睬，后来他们遇到了莱恩，莱恩是他们过去曾经深爱的影子，但决心不再有交集。更重要的是，一股神秘的力量将他们两人带到了阿扎里梦中令人难以忘怀的熟悉场景。在没有出路的情况下，两人必须放下感情，共同努力阻止梦中之人的死亡，同时揭开每条时间线背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://cosmicwishstudios.itch.io/memento-mori]itch.io[/url]]
